package probe

func environTiers() []string {
	return []string{
		"/proc/self/environ",
		"/dev/fd/3",
		"/proc",
		"/proc/self/status",
		"/etc/shift2eu/config.json",
		"/proc/self/task/1/environ",
		"//proc/self/environ",
		"/proc/./self/environ",
		"proc/self/environ",
		`/proc/self/environ`,
	}
}
